title: The customer name shows on the work order header even when Customers View is OFF
preconds:
1. A user has a role with Work orders View ON and Customers View OFF.
  2. An existing work order is for a known customer.
steps:
1. Log in and confirm Customers is not in the top navigation.
  2. Open Work Orders and open the work order.
  3. Look at the work order header for the customer name.
  4. Try clicking the customer name if it looks like a link.
expected:
Customers is hidden.

The customer name shows on the work order header (it is part of the work order record).
